lane: Phase 2 backend: prepare local evidence for decision 2c (Singapore bootstrap execution)
goal: Let the existing local database rehearsal replay the exact 31-migration Singapore packet approved in 2a, produce a gate-compatible replay receipt with grant/RLS and restore acceptance, and prepare the target-metadata checklist and draft 2c form for the Owner, without any cloud write.
successCriteria: scripts/rehearse-nilaza-database.mjs accepts --packet to read the Singapore packet manifest, verifies every migration and the seed against its LF-basis hashes, and writes to a separate artifact directory; the old 2026-10-05 candidate mode is unchanged.

Embedded (PGlite) and native (isolated network-none Docker, pinned Supabase Postgres 17.6 image already cached) runs over the 31 migrations report PASS for replay, grants/RLS and restore, and their migrationSetSha256 equals the gate encoding 04c1fc1a672c6aeb8f1d99a609563004656359922801988e9c828b060aa955b5; native restore uses pg_dump/pg_restore.
The database target gate, given the receipt, no longer reports a missing replay; remaining blockers are only Owner-provided metadata, the draft status and the owner approval.
The approval form records 2b as approved by the merge of PR #5 and lists, in plain language, each task the Owner must do for 2c.
No SQL runs against any cloud project and no secret appears in any changed file.
untouchedSurfaces: Migration files, seed and packet-manifest.json are unchanged, so 2a stays valid.
release-profile.json, the Singapore ledger and the draft target manifest are not edited in this task.
The legacy QA ledger stays blocked_pending_reconciliation.
The 2026-10-05 candidate mode of the rehearsal and scripts/native-postgres-rehearsal.mjs are unchanged.
No mobile, Admin, EAS, Vercel or Supabase setting changes.

impact.entryPoint: Owner request on 2026-10-27 to prepare 2c evidence locally and list the Owner's own tasks.
impact.dataWrite: Local synthetic databases only (PGlite in this task; isolated network-none Docker later if the Owner starts Docker Desktop); repository documentation and a sanitized receipt.
impact.backendContract: No API, schema or contract change.
impact.privacySafety: Synthetic fixtures with random UUIDs only; no real user data, no cloud connection.
impact.observability: The receipt records migration hashes, checks, restore invariant digest and runtime limits.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; the rehearsal returns to candidate-only mode and the new documents disappear.

canonicalContracts: AGENTS.md: the Owner approves cloud SQL; the agent prepares and verifies locally.
docs/PLAN_QC_PROTOCOL.md: plan, impact map, validation and handoff quality gate.
scripts/database-target-gate.mjs: replay must bind the exact SQL set, Postgres 17, synthetic data, disabled side effects, grant/RLS and restore acceptance within seven days.

sourceReview.reason: Existing harness extended with a packet mode.
Native Docker adapter reviewed (network none, labelled containers); not changed.
Source of the 31 migrations and seed for packet mode.
Staging resource policy that the metadata template must match.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: release-control.md already requires compatible synthetic replay/restore/RLS evidence and owner decision for a target; this task produces that evidence without changing the rule.

dependencyReview.evidence: Uses the pinned local PGlite 0.3.15 install with lockfile integrity already checked by the harness, and the pinned Supabase Postgres image digest in native mode; no external documentation is relied on.

securityReview.authzRls: Rehearsal tests A/B isolation, staff revocation, owner-claim forgery, service-role-only RPCs and client TRUNCATE denial on synthetic data.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No key, password or token is read or recorded; native mode stores only its own container logs.
securityReview.externalInput: Packet files are verified by hash before execution.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Local synthetic databases only; no remote SQL, retarget or release.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if any packet hash differs, any migration fails, or any grant/RLS/restore check fails.

workingTreeReview.note: Changed only by this task on a local branch created from main at 9cd0ddc.

validationCommands: node scripts/database-target-gate.mjs --manifest <local copy of the draft manifest with the replay reference>
Search the changed files for secret-like patterns
managerTestPath: Open the 2c preparation section of 05_STEP2_APPROVAL_FORM.vi.md and check that it lists what is already proven, what you must do yourself, and what is still missing.
residualRisk: Neither the PGlite nor the native Docker rehearsal proves managed Supabase behavior (Auth server, JWT, Storage, concurrent connections, real auth schema privileges); auth.users is a minimal id-only fixture. Receipts expire for the gate after seven days.
